newsitem.title: UK: Land Securities up after BZW recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Land Securities up after BZW recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Land Securities Plc rose on Wedesday after the stock was raised to a "buy" from a "hold" at BZW and the brokerage issued an "overweight" rating on the UK property sector, market sources said.
Land Securities was up 8p at 726-1/2 by 1238 GMT.
Sources said BZW argued that the UK property sector is fundamentally cheap, with yields at a premium to bonds and rental values growing.
Within the sector, the brokerage highlighted Land Securities as trading at a prospective discount to net asset value compared with a premium elsewhere in the sector, sources said.
Other property stocks also rose, with Slough Estates Plc up 6p at 264-1/2 and Hammerson Plc up 8-1/2p at 397.
